about.heading: About Me
about.body: I am a second year Mathematical and Computer Sciences student studying at the University of Adelaide. With a high interest in mathematics, I hope that my future will be directed into a position where I can utilise my passion for mathematics into industry.

projects.heading: Personal Projects
projects.intro: Here is a list of some of my favourite personal projects that I have done since the start of Uni. I tried to tackle a different language each time, and prioritised my interests.

items.title: Fourier Playground
items.description: A C++ project which utilises one of my favourite concepts in mathematics, the Fourier Transform. This project implements both the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) for vector drawing reconstruction and the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for real-time audio analysis.

items.title: 2026 Academy Awards Predictor
items.description: Developed a data science project to accurately predict the outcome of the 2026 Academy Awards using python and pandas, whilst also developing statistical methods such as Monte Carlo Simulations and Devigging.

items.title: Susquehanna Algothon
items.description: Participated to build a sophisticated trading algorithm in Python designed to maximize profits in a simulated trading environment, with the goal to have the most optimal Sharpe ratio.

music.heading: Music
music.blurb: Music is the most treasured part of my life. It's primarily the stream on how I get creative. Ever since high school, I have been deeply interested in discovering new music from a wild range of artists, where I used to do a project where I tried to listen to a new album every day for around 3-4 years, and it was amazing. Below are music recommendations I have for you, where I believe it has defined who I am.
